passages.provision_quote: The response and appeal procedure established under subsection (a)(3) must require the governing body to review the request at the next public meeting.
passages.note: HB 1447 is a multi-subject education act: the library chapter sits alongside Muncie school-corporation flexibility, third-party student surveys, political-neutrality rules, and obscenity-statute amendments.
Senate Roll Call 520 shows Donato voting Yea on the Conference Committee Report for HB 1447, a multi-subject education bill, with no statement tying the vote to the library provision.
Bill details page lists Donato as a Senate sponsor of HB 1447; the page's own digest text describes the student-survey provisions, not the library chapter.
passages.actor_quote: Sponsored by: Sen. Stacey Donato, Sen. Jeff Raatz

rows.reasoning: HB 1447 (2023) is a multi-subject education act: Sec. 2 (IC 20-26-5.5) sets a school-library removal-request and governing-body review process, but the same act also covers Muncie school-corporation flexibility, third-party student surveys, political-activity neutrality, and amendments to the obscenity statute. Donato voted Yea on the Conference Committee Report (Senate Roll Call 520) and is listed as a Senate sponsor, but nothing in the sources ties her vote or sponsorship specifically to the library provision, so under V4.1 the vote proves nothing about that clause on its own.
